title: Document the backup fetch's hard wait: decode deadline, two-second margin and one-minute cleanup grace
outcome: Document the backup fetch's hard wait: decode deadline, two-second margin and one-minute cleanup grace
acceptance: docs/features/cli-host-and-operator.md describes the fetch's cooperative decode deadline separately from the hard wait for its worker, including the two-second decode margin and the one-minute grace for partial-file cleanup, so --deadline-secs 60 is not read as a 60 s hard exit
